notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence high): Cooldown.xml is the shared CooldownFrame_SetTimer helper feeding a native cooldown widget. MSUI realizes the same shared machinery through CooldownVisualLaw plus the DrawCooldownSwipe/DrawCooldownFlash helpers, used by both the action bars (Program.ActionBars.cs) and bag item slots (Program.Inventory.cs ~line 1278). Not a surface of its own.
